representative elevation; band boundaries are midpoint heights. Visible elevation bands use nearest-height assignment. Unioned superlevel footprints are painted ascending, with lower fills extending underneath higher fills to avoid transparent antialiasing seams. Convex working pieces are Boolean-unioned per elevation using NonZero fill on the original i64 coordinate grid, preserving holes. One compound SVG path per superlevel footprint removes internal mesh edges; unioned outlines can be concave. Convexity uses exact i128 supporting-line predicates on normalized coordinates quantized to 1e-10 radius units. Only convex clipping primitives are canonicalized after rounding; concave terrain regions and merge candidates are never replaced with hulls. Inclusive elevation filters clip the working mesh before band quantization; excluded areas are transparent. No smoothing.","color_model":"Opaque #RRGGBB colors; rounded 8-bit sRGB channels. Gradient positions span the retained elevation endpoints unless color_range explicitly fixes a scale. Modes: encoded sRGB, linear-light sRGB, HSV shortest/longest hue path, or rainbow stops. Flat terrain uses the lowest color. Every-N patterns count base levels established by levels/interval after exclusion, anchored at the first base level at or above their start; inserted specific levels do not change pattern counting. Last matching pattern wins per attribute, then specific overrides, then no-fill/no-stroke switches. Stroke widths use non-scaling screen pixels and outline unioned elevation boundaries. Legacy gray is the reference grayscale channel, not custom-color luminance; fill is authoritative.","style":{"fill":{"lowest":"#ffffff","highest":"#000000","mode":"srgb","stops":[]},"stroke":{"lowest":"#888888","highest":"#888888","mode":"srgb","stops":[]},"stroke_width_px":1.0,"specific_fill":[],"specific_stroke_fill":[{"elevation_m":0.0,"color":"#000000"}],"specific_stroke_width":[],"no_fill":true,"no_stroke":false,"every_n_fill":[],"every_n_stroke_fill":[{"starting_elevation_m":0.0,"every":5,"color":"#000000"}],"every_n_stroke_width":[]},"source_accuracy_measured":false,"resampling_error_measured":false}
